relevance_note: Two first-hand LAMP2 cases: case 1 'carried a deletion mutation (c.257_258delCC) in exon 3 of the LAMP-2 gene' and case 2 was 'hemizygous for an LAMP-2 mutation, c.257_258delCC'.
method_note: Hand-extracted; a Python script only assembled the JSON and the 20-item checklists. Labels: the text uses 'case 1'/'case 2' (lowercase) most often. is_proband left null (two cases, neither called proband/index). Case 1's ablation sentence carries citation ^12 (Cheng & Fang 2012, WPW in a teenager with Danon disease), but the paper never states the patient was previously reported, so cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is null. Both cases carry the same variant c.257_258delCC; no family relationship is stated. Case 1 variant type recorded as 'other' from the authors' words 'deletion mutation' (not frameshift; not derived from HGVS); case 1 zygosity not stated. Contradictions/inconsistencies: (1) Conclusion says 'In our other case, 10-year follow-up showed progression of the hypertrophic phase to the dilated phase', whereas case 2 is 'currently suffering from hypertrophic cardiomyopathy' and authors are 'unsure if case 2 will develop DCM' (case 2 LVEF 61-63%); both rows emitted for case 2, checklist dilated item set to not reported. (2) Case 2 baseline LVEF 53% in text vs 55 in Table 2 (2014). (3) Case 1 text LVEDd 'from 44 to 58 mm' vs Table 2 2014 = 43; Table 2 2016 LVEF 55 vs Figure 2b 'preserved LVEF of 60%'. Time course in case 1: pansystolic murmur absent at 12, present at 17; liver/gastrocnemius LGE negative at 17, positive at 23; 'normal muscle strength' at 12 vs 'skeletal myopathy' stated at 23 (checklist muscle item recorded observed from the later statement). Case 2 'echocardiography was normal' at 10 is a whole-investigation normal finding, recorded as 'abnormal echocardiography' excluded without excluding narrower items. Table 2 echo values per year not transcribed as separate rows. Case 2 vital status 'alive' taken from 'currently suffering'.
